summary: Full backend + frontend regression after auth migration to Emergent Google OAuth. All 13 pytest cases pass (auth gate, invalid session_id, /auth/me with seeded token, /auth/logout invalidates, product CRUD + negative stock 422, customer society validation, order stock-decrement + overshoot 400 + status transitions + invalid-status 400, societies list). Browser flow with seeded session_token cookie loads dashboard, seller name/email visible, tab navigation works, order placement + status change + sign-out all pass. React key prop warnings: 0. Unauthenticated /dashboard correctly redirects to /.

issues: Seed avatar url via.placeholder.com/150 returns ERR_CONNECTION_CLOSED; consider a local/base64 fallback or omit picture in seed.

action_items: Cosmetic only: the DOM-nesting console error `<span> cannot be a child of <option>` originates from the Emergent visual-editor overlay script (assets.emergent.sh/scripts/emergent-main.js) wrapping dynamic children of <option> in a <span data-ve-dynamic style={display:contents}>. The application source at App.js:343 is clean (`<option>{c.name} · {c.society}</option>`), so no code change in the repo will silence it. If it must be removed, disable the visual editor overlay for <option> children or replace the dynamic children with a single string prop (e.g. compute label outside JSX).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:227 `update_status` uses a plain query-string `status: str` on a PATCH. Works but consider a Pydantic body model for consistency.

server.py:214 `create_order` reads stock then decrements without a transaction/atomic conditional update; a concurrent order can oversell. Use `find_one_and_update({id, stock: {$gte: qty}}, {$inc:{stock:-qty}})` for safety.
server.py:96 `create_session` trusts `data['session_token']` from Emergent as-is (not regenerated). Acceptable per playbook but worth noting.
App.js is 470 lines with many concerns in one file; splitting into components/*.jsx would improve maintainability.
test_credentials: Seed a session token in Mongo per /app/auth_testing.md (Google OAuth via Emergent; no app-managed password).
seed_data_creation: Tests seed and cleanup their own sellers/user_sessions. TEST_-prefixed products/customers/orders are created but not deleted (existing convention).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Old backend_test.py OTP tests were removed (OTP endpoints deleted this iteration). New tests seed sellers + user_sessions directly and pass Authorization: Bearer <session_token>. The remaining console warning about <span> in <option> is injected by the Emergent visual-editor overlay (emergent-main.js) and not present in app source — do not treat as an app bug.
rca of the issue: N/A — no regressions found this iteration.
